method: Linux/glibc host through public ECI, no audio device; observations do not establish audible NVDA/Windows/Android latency. Ordinary speech uses native speed 98; latency/recovery probes use speed 75.

startup_and_interruption.method:
Measure native time to first PCM and the return from an interrupted analysis.

Audio stays in RAM. Each library runs in its own process, without a playback
queue or device. These are host observations, not NVDA device latency claims.
The first callback cancels first-PCM probes; timed interruptions also measure
the following short utterance, so cancellation cleanup is part of the result.

cpu.method: 12 paired CPU samples per library, alternating order after warming; not a device guarantee

native_component_checks: cancel at native rule checkpoint before output
arena frame cursor restored after unwind
cancel nested English request and preserve parent landing and frame controls

before_frame_cleanup.label: early cancellation prototype, not the official 1.0 baseline

after_frame_cleanup.method: glibc mallinfo2 uordblks after cancellation and exact fresh speech, with Python gc.collect before each snapshot; not RSS

heap.identified_allocation_site: evv_land_place; skipped native frame pops generated new cached landing addresses
